extract_multimodal_features: run the Extract_Multimodal_Features class to extract fused video-text features and save them as a PyTorch tensor file
build_model_from_config: build the text unfused and fused models from a qfvs.json config file using dynamic attribute lookup
build_dataloader_for_uct_dataset: build a DataLoader from a UCTDataset with batch size 1 for processing video-text pairs
read_json_config: read a JSON config file and return an OrderedDict preserving key order for model architecture parameters
save_multimodal_features: save extracted multimodal features dictionary to a .pt file in the multimodal_features directory using torch.save
